Ben / Marissa — quick tech checklist and constraints so the bundle is audit-ready:

1) Selection criteria: 1 short (<=128 tokens), 1 medium (~512 tokens), 1 long (~2048 tokens). All synthetic user identifiers (tenant-xyz-001, etc.).
2) Fields to include per trace (CSV or JSONL): sequence_id, model_variant, request_ts, response_ts, total_tokens_in, total_tokens_out, fallback_used (bool), cache_event (hit/miss/partial), execution_node, trace_id.
3) KV-cache evidence: we cannot export raw cache contents. Provide metadata rows showing cache_key_hash, sequence_id, hit/miss, timestamp, and a short explanation of cache eviction heuristic.
4) Mapping doc: reference CSA controls mapping — use brief tags: CCM-OBS-01 (telemetry capture), CCM-OBS-02 (traceability/linkage), CCM-ISOL-04 (tenant isolation), CCM-CRY-03 (key material handling during export). Keep mapping one page, paragraph per control with artifact pointers.
5) Redaction rules: strip any plaintext request prompt examples; leave token counts and model labels.

I'll prepare the trace extraction script and produce a redacted_sequence_traces_v1.tar.gz containing JSONL traces + README. Marissa, can you produce kv-cache-annotation-20260519.csv and the mapping doc?

If we want to accelerate, I can hand over a single short trace tomorrow for Zenith to sanity-check.

-Jordan
Security Engineer (Controls)
Redwood Inference
